tools.name: request_access
tools.description: Ask a human for access to this server. Returns an approveUrl and a userCode: show BOTH to the person you are working with, ask them to open the link and check that the code on the page matches, then call poll_access. When the client supports URL elicitation, call poll_access with urlMode=true instea

tools.name: poll_access
tools.description: Collect the outcome of a request_access, proving possession of its deviceSecret. It HOLDS THE CALL OPEN and answers the moment the human decides — one call instead of a dozen, since each poll here costs a whole round trip through you. It waits 8 seconds by default; pass waitSeconds (up to 30) if you

tools.name: status
tools.description: Report readiness, the aggregate catalog set, and which host this is: `origin`, the canonical origin designs here are homed at, and `originAliases`, other hostnames that reach this same server.

tools.name: catalog_list_projects
tools.description: List every remote catalog with its stable id and preview count. Call this first: catalog_list_previews and catalog_list_data_products take one of these ids as 'catalog'.

tools.name: catalog_library
tools.description: Open the hosted preview catalog browser app. With no arguments it lists every catalog with its preview count only; pass projectId to list one catalog's previews. To find previews without the app, call catalog_list_projects, then catalog_list_previews with a catalog id. Also opens from the ChatGPT/Co

tools.name: catalog_list_previews
tools.description: List the Compose previews and published metadata of one hosted catalog. 'catalog' is required (ids from catalog_list_projects). tools.name: catalog_render_preview
tools.description: Render one preview. Like local compose-ai-tools, the default semantics observation is token-frugal; request observe=png for pixels, observe=svg for the compose/figma-svg vector export as SVG source, or observe=scroll-png / observe=scroll-svg for the full-page capture of a scrollable screen rather th

tools.name: catalog_render_matrix
tools.description: Render one preview across the cross-product of the given override 'axes' (or an explicit list of watch-face 'scenarios') in a single call, returning a hash/size observation per cell (observe=png adds the pixels). Prefer this over a catalog_render_preview per combination: the cells share one catalog

tools.name: catalog_list_devices
tools.description: List the `@Preview(device = ...)` ids this server's render lane recognises, with each one's dp size and density. The `device` override takes one of these ids; an unrecognised name renders the default frame rather than failing, so check here instead of guessing.

tools.name: catalog_diff_semantics
tools.description: Compare two previews' semantics by testTag: which tags are only in one side, which moved, and which changed occupancy count. Identity is the authored testTag, not a positional ref, so a tag that stops resolving is reported rather than silently retargeted at different pixels. Requires live grant scop

tools.name: catalog_history_list
tools.description: The render timeline for one preview: which versions of its rendered bytes exist, when each appeared, and whether the preview is unstable (re-renders differently on every publish) rather than genuinely changing. tools.name: catalog_history_diff
tools.description: Compare two of a preview's recorded renders. Defaults to the two newest — did the last publish move this preview? A metadata comparison: the timeline's versions are already collapsed distinct renders, so whether the bytes changed is answered without fetching either image. Reports `unstable` so a dif

tools.name: catalog_history_read
tools.description: Fetch one historical render's pixels through this server, by `commit` or `blob` (a prefix is enough). Use when an agent cannot reach the delivery branch itself, or wants the bytes rather than the timeline.

tools.name: catalog_list_data_products
tools.description: List the structured data-product kinds of one catalog, optionally one preview. Name the catalog with 'catalog' (ids from catalog_list_projects) or a preview 'uri'.

tools.name: catalog_get_preview_data
tools.description: Fetch the merged accessibility, annotation, or watchface/complications product for a preview. This lane requires live grant scope.

tools.name: list-all-documentation
tools.description: Storybook-MCP-compatible alias that lists every preview as a story.

tools.name: preview-stories
tools.description: Storybook-MCP-compatible rendering of one or more story ids. Requires live scope.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: request_access, poll_access · Private data: request_access, poll_access, catalog_render_preview · Public sink: catalog_render_matrix, catalog_history_list, catalog_history_diff.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: request_access, poll_access · Private data: request_access, poll_access, catalog_render_preview · Public sink: catalog_render_matrix, catalog_history_list, catalog_history_diff

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
